title: Rate Lock Commitment Cancellation Cooling, Program Change and Property Substitution Terms
content:
Each **Rate Lock Commitment** product sets its own cooling period after a borrower cancellation, program change fee and property substitution terms.

| Rate Lock Commitment product | Cooling period after a borrower cancellation (calendar days) | Program change fee (points) | Lock may move to a different property for the same borrower | Property substitution fee (points) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur 15-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | No | 0.000 |
| Larkspur 30-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | No | 0.000 |
| Larkspur 45-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | No | 0.000 |
| Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | Yes | 0.125 |
| Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | Yes | 0.125 |
| Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | Yes | 0.250 |
| Larkspur 180-Day New Construction Rate Lock | 30 | 0.125 | No | 0.000 |

**Definitions**

- **Cooling period**: the calendar days after a borrower cancels a lock during which a new lock on the same file is priced at worst case.
- **Program change fee**: the fee, in points to 3 decimals, added when the loan program changes while the file is locked.
- **Property substitution fee**: the fee, in points to 3 decimals, to move the lock to a different property. It is 0.000 where substitution is not allowed.

### Notes

- Property substitution is available on the Larkspur 60-Day Rate Lock and the Larkspur 90-Day Rate Lock at 0.125 points, and on the Larkspur 120-Day Extended Rate Lock at 0.250 points. The 15-, 30-, 45- and 180-day locks do not allow it.
